x: The 4 x 110 team of Merritt, Holtum, Jones and Mayers won their heat in 43.3secs., the fastest of the two, which looked as though we had a very good chance in the final.
We were weakened again in the senior events, Ron Holtum having the flu and Jack Brown unable to be present. Bob Taylor tried to contact Charlie Walker but failed.
Our 4 x 110 yds. team of Mayers, Carter, Jones and Holtum took second place in the final to T.V.H. We seem to have gathered a fine quartet of 440 men in Dollimore, Jackson, Leroy and Morris.

Our other competitors were Holtum, 3rd in the 100yds, and Pepe and Edwards 4th in the 880 yds. and javelin respectively. In recognition of our winning the trophy for three successive years, Carshalton Council made a nice gesture by presenting us with a special plaque.
We had triangular matches with Herne Hill H and Woodford Green AC and in the Senior 100 yards we saw Holtum finishing 3rd, and he followed this with a 4th in the 220.
